facts.fact: 山顶高原上龙群成群，Micah 初见震撼。
facts.anchor: Mount Embercrest opens onto a vast, breathtaking plateau beneath a gray sky.

facts.fact: Micah 认为龙不无故攻击，尊重即可相处。
facts.anchor: Respect their boundaries, and they’ll respect yours.

facts.fact: Micah 告诉 Maple 这里是它的归宿。
facts.anchor: “Alright, sweetheart.” I crouch beside her and scratch gently beneath her chin.

facts.fact: 一声尖啸后 Lucan 把 Micah 拉进灌木躲避黑龙。
facts.anchor: Lucan grabs me around the waist and pulls me behind a nearby bush.

facts.fact: 岩下聚集着几十只翅膀畸形的幼龙。
facts.anchor: Dozens of them. All juveniles or hatchlings with malformed wings.

facts.fact: Micah 意识到 Maple 并非孤例，忧心重重。
facts.anchor: I was wrong,” I whisper, shaking my head. “I thought Maple was an isolated mutation, but…

facts.fact: Lucan 把 Maple 装进背包避风。
facts.anchor: He opens his large backpack and carefully slips her inside

facts.fact: 山洞里 Lucan 招呼 Micah 靠他取暖。

facts.anchor: “In case you haven’t noticed, I’m quite smitten with you.”
